notes.title: Burger Witch - Hotfix v1.1.1
notes.notes:
[h3]🧙‍♀️ Welcome back, Witches![/h3][p]
We hear you! [b]This is the first hotfix based on community-mentioned bugs and recommendations. We are working on an additional hotfix to include a proper grading system and the ability to select the kitchen & more.

If you have any recommendations or are experiencing issues, please reach out using the [/b][url="https://steamcommunity.com/app/3552050/discussions/"]Steam Community[/url][b] or [/b][url="https://discord.com/invite/atNX56k5n7"]Discord[/url][b]. [/b]Thank you so much![/p][hr][/hr][h2]
Patch notes:[/h2][list][*][p]Ability to add a bun (bread) or a drink directly into a held plate.[/p][/*][*][p]Players will now have to hold the secondary interact key to cut ingredients instead of pressing multiple times (Cutting Counter).[/p][/*][*][p]Extra money bonus instead of bonus time.[/p][/*][*][p]Added the name of the current map on the pause menu (temporarily) to make it easier to know which map players are in. We are releasing an update that will let players select the kitchen (or randomized) very soon.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][b][i]This update does not require manual action; restart Steam to get the latest update automatically. [/i][/b]As always, thanks for playing and supporting us! Feel free to share your experience in the community or join our [url="https://discord.com/invite/atNX56k5n7"]🎙️ Official Discord Server[/url].[/p][hr][/hr][p]

notes.title: New Chaos - Burger Witch v1.1.0
notes.notes:
[h3]🧙‍♀️ Welcome back, Witches![/h3][p]We have a lot of new things to share with you in our first update, as well as what's to come![/p][hr][/hr][h3]This is the first update on our 2025 road map for Burger Witch.[/h3][p] In this update, we are experimenting with multiple new things, including the new expanded camera mode for motion sickness, a virtual cursor to fully support the gamepad, and the new cutting counter method to cut items.[/p][hr][/hr][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45527594/de8d465235bea9502cfc12c0f33267a5a6d49978.png"][/img][/p][hr][/hr][p]New & Added:
[/p][list][*][p] Redesigned Main Menu.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45527594/598cc2de86ff57c01b63489a2dd4eed24f7cfb6e.png"][/img][/p][/*][*][p] Redesigned Create Game Room.[/p][/*][*][p] Redesigned Lobby Room.[/p][/*][*][p] Completely Redesigned UI.[/p][/*][*][p] Added new kitchen (Blue Kitchen).

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45527594/104b077a8100012345a90cf35e30e72e6eae4247.png"][/img][/p][/*][*][p] Added a new modern font.[/p][/*][*][p] Added Virtual Cursor to fully support Gamepad players. Accessible via the left stick on a gamepad.[/p][/*][*][p] Added Expand Camera mode (Motion Sickness).

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45527594/cb3dad39e389d3c06f991c2c56014996413bb24d.png"][/img][/p][/*][*][p] Added Discord button.[/p][/*][*][p] Updated credits.
[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p]Fixes & Enhances:
[/p][list][*][p] Changed the Cutting Board method.[/p][/*][*][p] The game starts as soon as the player is ready, without a pre-game tutorial, and the player interacts with it to mark themselves ready.[/p][/*][*][p] Several changes have been made across all kitchens.[/p][/*][*][p] Multiple Fixes have been made across all UI & Gameplay.
[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p]Removed:
[/p][list][*][p] Highlighted Interaction Key.[/p][/*][*][p] Arabic Localization Support (Temporarily).
[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p] We're aware of some inconsistent bugs that occasionally happen, and we are determined to detect and fix them as soon as possible. Door physics are also experiencing incorrect collision weights, and we are working on a fix. And we are still evolving the game and working on the following in a separate hotfix update:
[/p][list][*][p] Fixing where two players or more try to drop an item on the same empty counter; it results in immediate destruction of the items, but not visually.[/p][/*][*][p] In-game name tags above players. [/p][/*][*][p] Adding more clarification for the potions/boosts in a Steam Guide. [/p][/*][/list][p] [/p][hr][/hr][p][b][i]This update does not require manual action; restart Steam to get the latest update automatically.
[/i][/b]
As always, thanks for playing and supporting us! Feel free to share your experience in the community or join our [url="https://discord.com/invite/atNX56k5n7"]🎙️ Official Discord Server[/url]. [/p][hr][/hr][p]

Developer of Burger Witch
Cyber752 Games[/p]

notes.title: New Chaos Awaits: Burger Witch Roadmap Revealed
notes.notes:
[h2]🧙‍♀️ Welcome back, Witches![/h2][h3]We have a lot of news for what is coming this year for all the witches out there![/h3][hr][/hr][p]We have identified several bugs and feature improvements needed in the game, and we are committed to delivering the best possible experience for our players. We sincerely apologize for any delays, but our goal is to roll out exceptional, theme-driven updates throughout the remainder of 2025.[/p][hr][/hr][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45527594/94b009f15d4fe5c45cf7387c258b110936fd66ad.png"][/img][/p][hr][/hr][h2]New Chaos (Fixes & Quality of Life):[/h2][list][*][p]This patch brings a wave of improvements focused on visual polish, usability, and accessibility.[/p][/*][*][p]Players will now enjoy item interaction animations for better feedback and a more immersive experience.[/p][/*][*][p]The potion description in the shop will provide clarity on potion effects.[/p][/*][*][p]A completely replaced village map and lobby environments enhance the game's atmosphere and flow. Name tags will be added above player characters for easier identification during gameplay. This patch aims to set the ground for the next updates.[/p][/*][*][p]Quality of life will also be a key focus. Players prone to motion sickness can now disable camera motion through a new setting.[/p][/*][*][p]Inconsistent bug fixes.
[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed where two players or more try to drop an item on the same empty counter; it results in immediate destruction of the items, but not visually.[/p][/*][*][p][i][b]This is the first update scheduled for release in August.[/b][/i][/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h2]Custom Chaos (Character & Kitchen Customization):[/h2][list][*][p]Introduces exciting new ways for players to personalize their gameplay experience. A full character customization system will be added, allowing players to select from new characters and tailor their appearances. The kitchen is now fully customizable as well, with a new layout editor that lets players move and replace counters and workstations to fit their preferred cooking setup.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h2]Sauce Chaos (Sauce & Safety Features):[/h2][list][*][p]Brings a mix of fiery excitement and safety tools to the kitchen. A brand-new fire extinguisher item will be introduced, allowing players to handle unexpected kitchen fires and maintain control during hectic gameplay. This new tool adds a layer of strategy and realism to chaotic cooking scenarios.[/p][/*][*][p]In addition, two new sauce items, Red Sauce and Yellow Sauce, expand the gameplay with more flavor and variety in meal preparation. Visual enhancements across the game will also be implemented, improving the overall graphics for a cleaner and more immersive experience.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h2]More Chaos:[/h2][list][*][p]Development is underway on the next major update. Stay tuned for sneak peeks and dev logs![/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p][/p][h3]Thank you all for your incredible patience and support as we continue to build and improve the game.

Your enthusiasm and feedback mean the world to us, and we can’t wait for you to experience everything we’ve been working on. Stay tuned, more chaos is just around the corner! 
[/h3][hr][/hr][p][b][i]This is not an update. It is an early preview of the upcoming updates. [/i][/b]As always, thanks for playing and supporting us! Feel free to share your experience or suggest new features in the community, or join our [url="https://discord.com/invite/atNX56k5n7"]🎙️ Official Discord Server[/url]. [/p][hr][/hr][p]

Developer of Burger Witch
Cyber752 Games[/p]

notes.title: Magic, Mayhem, & Medium-Rare – Burger Witch Joins the Fest!
notes.notes:
[h2]🧙‍♀️Magic meets mayhem in this frantic burger-crafting adventure! [/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45527594/5bf26cbd055584d271383212c9bab1f9b27fef2d.png[/img]

🎉 The Burger Witch demo is firing up its enchanted grill for Steam Next Fest, and you’re invited to jump into the magical madness between June 9–16.

[h3]🪄 What is Burger Witch?
[/h3]Assemble enchanted burgers, manage chaotic kitchen orders, and work with friends to meet your spooky quota before time runs out. Cook, cast, and conquer the kitchen, because in this dungeon, witches don’t brew potions, they grill patties!

[h3]🍟 Top 5 Spellbinding Features:
[/h3]

[h3]🧙‍♀️ Witches That Work the Grill
[/h3]Take control of adorable witches flipping burgers under pressure, no broomsticks needed!

[h3]🔥 Frantic & Funny Cooking Chaos
[/h3]Chop, grill, stack, and serve wildly magical ingredients before time runs out.

[h3]🎮 Single-Player & Co-op Multiplayer
[/h3]Solo or with a friend, cast your way to burger greatness!

[h3]🧅 A Dungeon Full of Delicious Disasters
[/h3]Each level introduces quirky challenges, from shifting floors to picky ghost customers.

[h3]🍄 Aesthetic That’s Equal Parts Cute & Cursed
[/h3]Colorful cartoon visuals meet whimsical witchy charm.

[h3]🧪 Don’t Miss the Demo!
[/h3]Ready to cook with chaos? Then don’t miss your chance to play the Burger Witch demo during Steam Next Fest and add the game to your wishlist.
